blocking_findings.reason: Primary Fig. 8b/c and the CCK-8 method describe concentration-series NIH-3T3 and HCT-116 viability assays for Nisin, NP-AgNPs2, and P-AgNPs at 0.2, 0.4, 0.8, 1.6, and 3.2 mg/mL, with CK controls. The final activity_toxicity_evidence.json contains only five cell-viability rows: one nisin NIH-3T3 range, NP-AgNPs2/P-AgNPs at 0.4 mg/mL for NIH-3T3, and NP-AgNPs2/P-AgNPs at 0.2 mg/mL for HCT-116. None of those rows cite Fig. 8b/c, and the final has no source-backed exclusion for the remaining dose-series bars. Because hemolysis Fig. 8a was accepted as approximate_from_figure, omitting the adjacent CCK-8 figure panels without row-level records or exclusions leaves a source-present toxicity/selectivity surface incomplete.
